content.short: Bitstamp is a cryptocurrency exchange founded in 2011 and based in Luxembourg.
content.description: Bitstamp, established in 2011 and based in Luxembourg, offers a clear cryptocurrency platform that enables you to access, stake, trade, and purchase over 70 cryptocurrencies. The basic services are accessible via both the web interface and the mobile app, providing a straightforward way to manage crypto activities. Optional pro trading services are available for users who need advanced tools and enhanced capabilities beyond the core offering.
